courses.title: Digital Marketing Fundamentals for Beginners
courses.shortDescription: Learn the core skills of digital marketing and start promoting online with confidence.
courses.description:
This live online course introduces women to the essentials of digital marketing. Participants will learn how social media platforms work, how to create simple content plans, and how to promote products or services online. All classes are conducted live via Zoom with practical exercises and Q&A sessions.

DEMO DATA – for testing only.
courses.schedule: Every Tuesday and Thursday, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM PKT
learningOutcomes: Understand the basics of digital marketing
Create a simple social media content plan
Promote a product or service online
requirements: Basic ability to use WhatsApp and Facebook
